policy: C2196 KN18 iteration-6 at 768P. Two close-up burns of a point-light sky both came back RED at 768P (p99 26/79/69 then 27/80/74 against a threshold of 47) while the wide sibling KN17 is green at 32/31/32 on the same workflow. Keyframe measurement settles the cause: KN_KN18.png is nearly empty (p99 19, median 16) where KN_KN17.png already holds its field (p99 37). An empty sky plus point-light vocabulary makes the model tile the frame with regular glowing lamps and vertical streaks. This iteration keeps the shot's window and its job in the cut (a tight breathing beat between the two wide galaxy shots) but re-specifies the subject as drifting warm dust haze with no point lights at all, so there is nothing to tile. Lane bmc int8 1344x768, seed 102675 unchanged. Writes clips-local-768/KN_G6-KN18.mp4.

units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. A close-up at eye level; the camera drifts slowly to one side with small amplitude in shallow focus, easing in at the start and settling to a stop at the end. Fine warm dust suspended in near darkness: a continuous soft veil of out-of-focus motes and faint warm grains, drifting slowly and unevenly the way dust moves through a lamp-lit room, the grains clumping here and thinning there at their own pace, some soft and rounded, others a faint short streak carried along by the drift. The darkness behind the veil stays deep, unlit and empty, opening out gently to the edges of frame. Warm 2000 Taiwanese telecine grade, milky lifted blacks. Visible 35mm film grain. Restrained continuous motion, camera and subject motion only.
